summary: Phase 1 — Comms Centre / shared Campaign Engine: backend (24/24 pytest passed = 100%) and frontend Playwright UI smoke (login -> /comms -> create -> EmailBuilder -> save) all green. Module switcher pill 'Comms Centre' active, 4 context view pills present and filter correctly, stat cards render, new-campaign modal opens, create-type is a SELECT, Create & build opens drag-and-drop EmailBuilder with subject, palette items (heading/text/button/image/footer etc), preview toggles (desktop/mobile/dark), Save (PUT) and Test buttons. Test-send modal confirm button (data-testid='test-send-confirm') was NOT found after clicking builder-test — only minor gap.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking builder-test the modal did not expose a [data-testid="test-send-confirm"] within ~1s. Either the testid is named differently (e.g. test-send-submit), the modal opens lazily, or it requires extra interaction. Worth confirming.

action_items: Verify test-send modal exposes data-testid='test-send-confirm' on the primary 'Send test' action; if it's named differently, update EmailBuilder to match the spec (or notify spec).
critical_code_review_comments: comms.py is well-structured; one watch-out: list_comms_campaigns applies module/type/status/q filters in Python AFTER fetching up to 500 docs per org — fine at current scale, push to Mongo as data grows.
Status transition map allows 'archived' -> 'draft' which effectively un-archives a soft-deleted campaign. Confirm that's intentional vs. immutable archive.
duplicate_comms_campaign does {**src}; if src ever contained nested mutable refs they would be shared. Phase 1 fields are flat-ish so OK, but consider copy.deepcopy for safety.
ObjectId is correctly excluded via {"_id": 0} on reads and pop in _public_campaign — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all primary testids resolved; only test-send-confirm missing)

seed_data_creation: Created ~12 TEST_-prefixed campaigns in marketing_campaigns collection during backend tests (TEST_pytest_newsletter, TEST_ma, TEST_sf, TEST_nl, TEST_q_*, TEST_status, TEST_invalid_status, TEST_archive) and one TEST_UI_campaign_pw via the UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file is /app/backend/tests/test_comms_phase1.py — run from /app/backend (not /app) because conftest at /app/backend/tests imports tests.shared_loop. Login endpoint is /api/auth/login. The only outstanding question is the test-send modal's confirm button data-testid.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Pre-existing CSP errors blocking external posthog/cloudflare scripts are unrelated to Comms feature.
